knowledge_graph.title: Avon High School
knowledge_graph.description: Avon High School is a 4-year high school in Avon, Hendricks County, Indiana. It is a part of the Avon Community School Corporation. The district includes the vast majority of Avon and portions of Danville and Plainfield.
knowledge_graph.address: 7575 E County Rd 150 S, Avon, IN 46123
knowledge_graph.school_types: High school, State school, Public school
knowledge_graph.raw_hours: Closes soon · 4 PM · Opens 7 - 30 AM Fri
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "We are one of the top public high schools in the state of Indiana and a 2023 National Blue Ribbon School. We serve a growing enrollment of approximately 3,500 students in grades 9-12 who live in Avon and Washington Township. We are Avon. We are One."
